data.name: IDS_DESC_M16
data.value: Assault rifle. Fires 3-round bursts and hits hard at long range. Very accurate when aimed. Uses 5.56 rounds.

data.name: IDS_DESC_FLINTLOCK_COPPER
data.value: Single-shot pistol. Loads from gunpowder. Heavy hitting and accurate when aimed.

data.name: IDS_DESC_FLINTLOCK_IRON
data.value: Heavy single-shot pistol. Hits hardest and lasts longest, but is the slowest to reload. Loads from gunpowder.

data.name: IDS_DESC_FLINTLOCK_GOLD
data.value: Single-shot pistol. Reloads fastest and enchants easily, but wears out quickly. Loads from gunpowder.
